definitions.gloss: a person who is easily scared; a scaredy-cat; a coward
definitions.explanation: someone who is frightened easily or afraid of many things

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{怖|こわ}がり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ホラー{映画|えいが}→ホラー映画：25725_horaaeiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られない→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I'm a scaredy-cat and can't watch horror movies.

examples.japanese: {怖|こわ}がりだ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦お{化|ば}け{屋敷|やしき}→お化け屋敷：18623_obakeyashiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I'm easily scared, but I gathered my courage and went into the haunted house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{怖|こわ}がり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧なかった。
examples.english: As a child, I was easily frightened and couldn't go into dark rooms alone.

notes:
FORMS:
{怖|こわ}がる (to be scared) + り (nominalizer) → a person who gets scared

COMMON PATTERNS:
Formed from the verb {怖|こわ}がる (to be scared/to fear), using the stem + り pattern that creates a noun describing a person with that tendency.

SIMILAR FORMATIONS:
- {寂|さび}し⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (person who gets lonely easily)
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shy person)
- ⟦{照|て}れ{屋|や}→照れ屋：18529_tereya⟧ (easily embarrassed person)

Note: {怖|こわ}がり can stand alone, while other similar words often add ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{臆病|おくびょう}→臆病：07608_okubyou⟧ (cowardly, timid)
- ビビり (scaredy-cat - slang)
- ⟦{小心者|しょうしんもの}→小心者：18645_shoushinmono⟧ (timid person)
